info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Parking Reservations Violations-v5-spec
info.description: This API provides access to the list of violations associated with parking reservations. It enables users to retrieve detailed information about each violation, including applicable penalties and reservation details. Key stakeholders include parking management teams, enforcement authorities, and data analysts who require insights into parking compliance. This endpoint facilitates enhanced operational oversight and decision-making regarding parking enforcement and reservation management.

get.summary: Retrieve a list of violations for reservations.
get.description: This endpoint allows developers to fetch a detailed list of violations associated with reservations. Utilize this endpoint to monitor and manage compliance and avoid any infractions.

requestBody.description: A JSON object representing the details of reservations violations that need to be retrieved. This request body is used to specify the criteria for filtering the violations in the response.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning the requested violations data.
